article.hook: Someone just signed up for a course they can’t finish. Jupiter in Sagittarius throws open the door to ideas too big to hold. It’s the itch to start something vast, even if the finish line isn’t clear yet.
article.lived: Over the next year, you’ll see people doubling down on quests that push their limits - a coworker switching careers after a weekend seminar, a team pitching a project that feels more like a manifesto than a plan. The pace is long enough to build new habits but short enough to spark impatience. We lean into conversations that stretch past small talk, trading quick opinions for grand debates on meaning, purpose, and what’s worth risking.
article.turn: The problem hits when boldness turns to bulldozing, and curiosity slides into certainty. Someone at the table insists their view is the only truth, shutting down questions instead of opening them. Growth stalls when the quest becomes a crusade, and the horizon shrinks to a single, unshakable belief.
moves: Host a debate night where no idea is off-limits but every opinion must be questioned.
Draft a plan for a project with a built-in checkpoint to rethink the original goals.
Write a letter to your future self about what you want to learn, then let it go unread until this transit ends.
